title: AI Centerのメンバー1人がThe 20th Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligenceに参加しました
body: The 20th Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence（太平洋地域国際AI会議）にて、AI R&D Centerのメンバー1名が国際学会で発表しました。
references: Yamatomi, Ryo, Shahrzad Mahboubi, and Hiroshi Ninomiya. "Generative Model of Suitable Meme Sentences for Images Using AutoEncoder." Pacific Rim International Conference on Artificial Intelligence. Singapore: Springer Nature Singapore, 2023.
